#!/bin/bash
# Fabric MC Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Catalyst maintained copy: critical failures must not end in a success echo.
set -o pipefail

apt-get update || exit "$?"
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl jq unzip dos2unix wget || exit "$?"
mkdir -p /mnt/server || exit "$?"
cd /mnt/server || exit "$?"

# Enable snapshots. jq -e also rejects an empty selection; pipefail preserves
# curl's status when metadata retrieval fails.
if [ -z "$MC_VERSION" ] || [ "$MC_VERSION" == "latest" ]; then
  MC_VERSION=$(curl -fsSL https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/game | jq -er 'first(.[] | select(.stable == true) | .version) // empty') || exit "$?"
elif [ "$MC_VERSION" == "snapshot" ]; then
  MC_VERSION=$(curl -fsSL https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/game | jq -er 'first(.[] | select(.stable == false) | .version) // empty') || exit "$?"
fi

if [ -z "$FABRIC_VERSION" ] || [ "$FABRIC_VERSION" == "latest" ]; then
  FABRIC_VERSION=$(curl -fsSL https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/installer | jq -er '.[0].version // empty') || exit "$?"
fi

if [ -z "$LOADER_VERSION" ] || [ "$LOADER_VERSION" == "latest" ]; then
  LOADER_VERSION=$(curl -fsSL https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader | jq -er 'first(.[] | select(.stable == true) | .version) // empty') || exit "$?"
elif [ "$LOADER_VERSION" == "snapshot" ]; then
  LOADER_VERSION=$(curl -fsSL https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader | jq -er 'first(.[] | select(.stable == false) | .version) // empty') || exit "$?"
fi

wget -O fabric-installer.jar "https://maven.fabricmc.net/net/fabricmc/fabric-installer/$FABRIC_VERSION/fabric-installer-$FABRIC_VERSION.jar" || exit "$?"
java -jar fabric-installer.jar server -mcversion "$MC_VERSION" -loader "$LOADER_VERSION" -downloadMinecraft || exit "$?"
mv server.jar minecraft-server.jar || exit "$?"
mv fabric-server-launch.jar server.jar || exit "$?"
printf '%s\n' "serverJar=minecraft-server.jar" > fabric-server-launcher.properties || exit "$?"
echo "Install Complete"
